Ky Fan inequalities transfer the coefficient. Algebraic identities and independent kernel integration were checked; finite tests are supplementary.

value.rationale: The natural object is the infinitesimal operator associated with a genuine Hilbert–Schmidt path of two boundary-contact composition operators. Its exact spectral decay shows a critical weak-trace but non-trace-class tangent, quantitatively distinguishing mere Hilbert–Schmidt smoothness from nuclear regularity. The sharp 32 sqrt(2)/pi coefficient is tied to the exact geometry of the boundary jet via a computable Sturm–Liouville length, not an arbitrary finite parameter slice.
